rationale: The scientific story contains three linked but inferentially distinct components: Palmer discovery, prospective Signy replication, and MAPPPD regional scale transfer.
Ecology's September 2026 guidance describes Articles as more complicated stories with distinct components and Reports as concise statements on a single simple topic.
The Article package preserves the evidence hierarchy, statistical differences across scales, and limitations without compressing them into Supporting Information.
The verified Word Main Document is 24 pages before separate figure pages; with three one-page main figures the expected submission page count is 27, below the 30-page Article limit.

alternate_package.activation_rule: Use only after an explicit author decision or an editorial request to recast the paper as a Report. Before activation, render and verify the complete Report package against the 20-page limit.
alternate_package.scientific_difference: No new analysis; the Report compresses the same evidence and moves post-hoc/contextual material to Supporting Information.

canonicality_rule: Exactly one initial-submission package may be active. The Article package is active; the Report package is retained as an alternate and must not be uploaded in parallel.
scientific_freeze: No journal-format choice authorizes new ecological analyses.
